The architecture com-bines hypothesis generation, causal reasoning, falsification, formal verification, andpersistent orchestration through a shared memory state that records assumptions,counterexamples, interventions, and proof obligations. By treating failed predictionsand invalid proof attempts as useful learning signals, the framework shifts discoveryfrom fluent claim production toward disciplined claim survival. On simulated dis-covery tasks, the full system improves verified discovery rate from 0.42 to 0.76 andreduces false-positive hypothesis retention from 0.31 to 0.08.
